source: IPdeny country allocation lists; CN excludes HK/MO/TW; continent grouping is explicit in regions.json
dnsmasq: 2.91 statically linked; synchronous IPset ACK; see source package

formats.*.delta: sorted IPv4 network delta in unsigned LEB128, followed by prefix byte
formats.cn.frontcode: sorted reversed domain labels; previous common-prefix length byte, suffix length byte, suffix ASCII

region_updates: Validated HTTPS country snapshots; persistent versions in /etc/mnt/ikuai/region-iplib; managed by native IP groups
domain_updates: Validated HTTPS mainland domain snapshots; .hk/.mo/.tw excluded; complement is outside mainland; persistent versions in /etc/mnt/ikuai/domain-iplib; manual overrides in strict-routing.json
